title: What Does the Question Mark Mean?
instructions: What does the `?` mean in the type `String?`?

options.text: The variable must always hold a String
The variable can hold a String or null
The variable is a question to the user
The variable will be deleted after use

explanation: The `?` after a type name makes it nullable. `String?` means the variable can hold either a real String value or null. Without the `?`, the variable must always hold a non-null String.
